diagnostics.message: google_compute_organization_security_policy_association.attachment attaches hierarchical firewall policies whose IDs are supplied via var.firewall_policy_attachments, but the module itself creates those policies as google_compute_organization_security_policy.policy. Because the association references only the variable, Terraform may create the association before (or concurrently with) the policy, and the GCP addAssociation API will fail with 'policy not found' on a fresh apply. An explicit depends_on on the policy resource is needed to enforce the real-world creation order.
